architect_intent.statement: Demonstrate that Kalaxy3/SAGE can take a meaningful first-party change from stakeholder intent through portable build, exact artifact promotion, live runtime verification, and learning without depending on a particular development machine or workflow engine.

stakeholder_concerns: runtime readiness sufficient for the intended proof

experience_inventory_queries.question: What accumulated evidence is available around building once and promoting the same artifact?
experience_inventory_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Likely relevant to reproducibility and portable delivery.

experience_inventory_queries.question: What accumulated evidence is available around recovery when Git or GitHub advances independently?
experience_inventory_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Likely relevant to reducing operator intervention and stale workflow assumptions.

experience_inventory_queries.question: What accumulated evidence is available around externally reachable zero-trust runtime behavior?
experience_inventory_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Likely relevant to external user access and security.

experience_inventory_queries.question: What accumulated evidence is available around objective-sized execution and learning?
experience_inventory_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Likely relevant to governed delivery and learning from the episode.

intent_experience_queries.question: Which evidence candidates may transfer to portable build and exact promotion?
intent_experience_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Potential direct or analogous experience; applicability must still be judged.

intent_experience_queries.question: Which evidence candidates may transfer to live zero-trust verification?
intent_experience_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Potential runtime/security experience; current readiness remains a separate question.

intent_experience_queries.question: Which evidence candidates may transfer to low-intervention recovery?
intent_experience_queries.llm_relevance_hypothesis: Potential evidence for avoiding replay and needless operator round trips.

llm_innovations.proposal: Use a meaningful first-party SAGE experience change as the end-to-end workload rather than inventing a disposable demonstration application.
llm_innovations.why: Would make delivery proof and stakeholder-visible value part of the same episode.

llm_innovations.proposal: Before committing to the full live episode, run a bounded readiness check that asks only whether the current cluster and delivery path can support the intended proof.
llm_innovations.why: High information gain if cluster readiness is uncertain; avoids broad infrastructure hardening without evidence.

llm_innovations.proposal: Treat newly discovered infrastructure deficiency as relevant only when it blocks or materially risks the stakeholder outcome.
llm_innovations.why: Preserves the 80/20 objective rather than turning the proof into a cluster modernization project.

unresolved_questions: Is the current Kalaxy3 cluster sufficiently ready to host the intended live proof without unrelated hardening?
Which first-party change creates enough stakeholder-visible value to make the end-to-end proof meaningful?
Which historical evidence is directly transferable versus merely analogous to this exact objective?
What runtime evidence is portable in Git and what remains available only on particular executors?

human_decisions.decision: Choose whether to buy a small amount of cluster/readiness information before authorizing the full end-to-end episode.
Choose the meaningful first-party workload/change whose stakeholder value justifies the end-to-end proof.

tactical_options.expected_stakeholder_value: Reduces uncertainty about whether the live proof is currently feasible.
tactical_options.risk: May reveal a genuine blocker that changes the next objective.

tactical_options.expected_stakeholder_value: Produces the strongest direct proof if current infrastructure is already sufficient.
tactical_options.risk: Could mix product proof with avoidable infrastructure diagnosis if readiness is weaker than assumed.
High chance of solving infrastructure concerns that are not material blockers to the intended proof.
